acceptanceCriteria: In packages/init/lib/scaffold.mjs within ensureGitignore, after checking that required lines are present, evaluate whether the effective gitignore contract is satisfied (via git check-ignore probe when git is available, or rule ordering evaluation)

When required committable paths (.adlc/config.json, .adlc/manifest.jsonl, .adlc/tickets/.store.json, .adlc/manifest.d/seg-1.jsonl) would be ignored by a mis-ordered .gitignore (e.g. .adlc/* placed after negation rules), do not report 'unchanged' / 'already current'
Record a warning in result.warnings describing the mis-ordered gitignore rules, causing init to exit non-zero (exit 1) and not report 'already current'
Add a test in packages/init/test/misordered-gitignore.test.mjs or gitignore-manifest.test.mjs reproducing the mis-ordered .gitignore failure
Update documentation in packages/init/README.md, docs/tools/init.md, and apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/init.mdx
title: init: ensureGitignore is set-membership only; mis-ordered .gitignore reads 'already current', negations dead (#665)
